title: On the defocusing stationary nonlinear Schrödinger equation on metric graphs
summary: We study the defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on noncompact metric graphs under general self-adjoint vertex conditions ensuring the existence of a negative eigenvalue of the Hamiltonian operator. First, we focus on the existence of energy ground states with prescribed mass. We show that existence and stability always hold for small masses and fail for large masses in the $L^2$-subcritical regime.
